GTA 6 Car Theft Has a Catch: Getting In Isn't the Same as Driving Off 🚗🔑

short // Nov 19, 2026

Watch on YouTube

Think you can just hop into any parked car in GTA 6 and drive off? Hold up. 🚗🔑

For about 25 years, stealing a parked car in GTA meant walking up and taking it. Rockstar says GTA 6 adds a few more steps.

What changed

Rockstar's Rob Nelson says stealing cars works differently now. You might use a slim jim to get inside a parked car. With some cars, you can smash the window and climb in, and you'll still need a key cloner just to start the thing. Kotaku's report

What didn't

You can still pull a driver out at a stoplight. The old-school carjack is still on the menu. So the real question is which way you're going.

This is how Rockstar described the system before launch. How often each car needs which tool is something players will be mapping out for a while, so take the details as the starting point, not the whole rulebook.

Quick answers

Is car theft harder in GTA 6? For some parked cars, yes. Rockstar's Rob Nelson says you might need a slim jim to get in, and some cars need a key cloner to start even after you smash the window.

Can you still carjack in GTA 6? Yes. Pulling a driver out at a stoplight still works, according to the same report.

Your turn

What's your first move: work the parked car, or old-school carjack at the light?
